purpose: Independently review PR #84 (the stop on a provider refusing the account, and seven lessons) at exactly its bound head. The owner asked for it as one coordinator action on 2026-11-21. The merge decision is the owner’s.

base.note: the merge base of the head with main when this record was bound (main was then 4e5cdd2a8cc7ae0cd665f3c6c481e42c79f5340c); the PR is judged against it

author.note: an Anthropic model wrote every commit of the PR; Anthropic does not review its own work

panel.tests: relayed: Codex, on the owner’s subscription, picks an authorized test; the runner runs it in its verify jail on the review copy of the head and returns the result for Codex to judge (pantheon/src/review-runner/relay.mjs). Codex’s own sandbox cannot start the verify jail (register L-404).

telos.note: the TELOS commit CI pins; the owner’s configured checkout is used and its head is recorded against this

bound_by: the coordinator (an Anthropic model): it binds and dispatches, and never reviews or merges
